cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Genre hybridity is the combination of conventions from two or more distinct genres within a single film, creating a new blended category.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Sub-genres are more specific categories within a broader genre, such as slasher horror within horror or space opera within science fiction.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Genre mixing has become increasingly common in contemporary cinema as studios seek to attract wider and more diverse audiences.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Postmodern genre theory argues that in a media-saturated culture, pure genres no longer exist — all contemporary films are to some extent hybrid.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Frederic Jameson argued that postmodern culture is characterised by pastiche — the imitation of genre styles without the original satirical impulse of parody.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Genre hybridity allows filmmakers to combine the pleasures of multiple genres: the emotional intensity of romance with the spectacle of action.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Sub-genres develop as genres mature and diversify, with audiences seeking increasingly specific experiences within a familiar framework.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: The evolution of sub-genres reflects changing social concerns: eco-horror mirrors environmental anxiety, cyberpunk reflects digital culture fears.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Some hybrids become established genres in their own right: the romantic comedy, the action-thriller and the sci-fi western are now recognised categories.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Genre hybridity can create tonal complexity but also risks confusing audience expectations if the blend is not handled coherently.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Intertextuality — the referencing of other texts within a film — is a key feature of postmodern genre cinema.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genre Hybridity & Sub-genres
cards.back: Analysing hybrid genres requires identifying which conventions come from which parent genre and explaining what the combination achieves.
